reason: The latest macro validation HR@10 of 0.39 trails the baseline’s 0.505, particularly on CDs_and_Vinyl (0.28 versus 0.48) and Movies_and_TV (0.44 versus 0.58); reduced supervision from one target per prefix is a plausible, unproven cause. Dense supervision requires coordinated sampler, loss, and training-loop changes. Historical sampled-softmax successes support retaining that objective, while failed recency-weighting experiments favor uniform supervision within each user and an unchanged SASRec architecture.
